source.name: Colorado Rapids: 'Colorado Rapids announce Kiewit as official jersey sleeve partner'
source.quote: the Kiewit logo will appear on the right sleeve of all Colorado Rapids authentic primary and secondary jerseys
source.note: The page itself carries no dateline; the club's announcement posts on Facebook and X and the Denver Business Journal dateline both show 4 July 2025. Neither the club release nor the open press reports a deal value.

note: Kiewit is also the club's Official Construction and Engineering Partner; the logo also appears on Rapids 2 and Rapids Academy jerseys. For Soccer's 2026 MLS jersey-sponsor list confirms Kiewit on the right sleeve for the 2026 season.
